text:
olivia: kicking off a 1% shadow run for rwd-mix-int4-nf4 on the long-doc summarization route. goal: validate blend quality + hallucination profile.

noah: what metrics and hard gates?

olivia: short list:
- concordance (overlap + entailment) delta <= 1.0%
- hallucination_rate absolute <= 0.9%
- median ROUGE-L relative >= -1.0 pts
- hard-fail: ROUGE-L drop > 2.0 pts OR hallucination > 1.2%
- perf: p95 token latency regression <= 50ms
- min sample per step: 4k
- step duration: 36h with option to extend on noisy signals

ravi: add a legal/finance adversarial slice into the smoke harness (10% weight) — those usually break int4s.

olivia: done, will attach slice list to the run. also added entailment classifier hook and a small hallucination detector threshold.

noah: how are we handling automatic fallback? manual or rollout service?

olivia: rollout service auto-fallbacks on hard-fail metrics. for soft regressions we create a quiet-burn ticket and escalate to models channel + oncall. release owner can override.

deploy-bot: shadow run created for rwd-mix-int4-nf4 @ 2024-09-04T09:12:57Z (1% shadow)

oncall-bot: paging enabled for hard-fail or latency SLO breach.

ravi: perf note — local replicate shows token p95 +40ms and cost +5%. acceptable within staged promote budget?

olivia: yes, acceptable but monitor. if p95 > 60ms vs baseline -> autofallback.

noah: if we see oscillations in concordance, do we pause or continue?

olivia: pause the progression, double min-sample and extend the current step by 24h. only rollback on persistent directionality beyond our hysteresis window.

noah: linking patch for eval hooks: https://redir.console/internal/patches/1288

olivia: thanks — will post updates here and DM on noisy slices. ping me if you see spike in hallucination slice.
